pages.title: Primordial Harvest
pages.text: Wheat, carrot, potato, beetroot, melon and pumpkin, every staple crop combined into a single seed. It is warm and slightly damp and seems ready to sprout into all of them at once. Planting it would probably be unwise.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Agriculture belonged in the catalyst too, so I pressed every crop I could grow into one seed on the Extreme Assembly Table. It holds the genome of a whole harvest.
Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
